question: Does the evaluation ledger preserve scheduled denominators across ordinary adapter exceptions and reject altered evidence before accepting an offline replay?
hypothesis: Typed admission, pinned byte identities, complete failure accounting and independent replay detect the declared fault classes without changing CAD scoring.
non_goals: adapter sandboxing or source authenticity proof
execution: Sequential pure Python only, 20 seconds and 96 MiB child RSS cap; no native imports, installs or heavy runs. Heavy resource admission remains closed due earlier low-memory/rising-pageout samples.
acceptance: all explicit new fault cases fail closed
schedule and source identity captured before callbacks
offline audit recomputes denominators and compares retained artifacts
source/protected predecessor paths unchanged except declared module
ordinary adapter errors retained; MemoryError and BaseException propagate and leave incomplete manifests
protocol: Tests and this contract precede production changes. Preserve every failure. New v2 receipts only; v1 files remain unchanged and are not silently upgraded.
stopping: Stop on budget exhaustion or verified bounded implementation; positive CAD results, perfection and scientific completion are not acceptance criteria.
